substantive_commits.summary: Add an InitializeOnLoad fail-closed guard that independently revalidates any persisted Visual Fidelity PASS and invalidates it when current evidence/provenance/candidate/gate state can no longer be proven.
Add the machine-readable Visual Fidelity result freshness contract and SHA-256-bound runtime report requirements.

problem_found: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate correctly validates real 4K still/temporal evidence and writes PASS/FAIL after scoring, but its result file is written only after several fail-closed validators complete.

If an older PASS result already exists and a later evaluation throws before WriteJson(ResultPath, result), the old visual_fidelity_result.json can remain on disk even though current reviewed evidence, candidate freshness, provenance, or scoring contracts are no longer valid.

QualityBlockRenderCandidateFreshnessQA invalidates the render receipt when the candidate changes, but it does not invalidate visual_fidelity_result.json itself. Therefore a consumer looking only at the persisted result file could mistake a stale PASS for the current candidate.

automatic_behavior: InitializeOnLoad bootstrap plus Editor project/hierarchy monitoring
only positive PASS assertions are protected; FAIL/UNSCORED states are not converted into PASS
an existing PASS re-runs visual gate integrity, reviewed-evidence integrity, render provenance, current candidate freshness and temporal candidate coherence
category totals are independently recomputed against the immutable 20/20/15/10/10/8/7/5/5 weights and 18/18/13/9/9/7/6/4/4 hard minima
the current reviewed total must remain >=92, every critical defect must remain absent, and the persisted result score/threshold must equal current evidence
any validation exception replaces the previous PASS with INVALIDATED_REEVALUATION_REQUIRED and visualScore=0; the guard never emits PASS
a machine-readable freshness report hashes the result, reviewed evidence, still receipt/seal/epoch/manifest, temporal receipt/coherence seal and key gate contracts

critical_gate_reasoning.risk_addressed: stale PASS persistence after an early fail-closed validation exception
critical_gate_reasoning.why_priority: A numeric 92/100 gate is not trustworthy if an earlier PASS artifact can survive candidate/evidence drift. This is an evidence-lifecycle integrity defect rather than a pixel-quality improvement, so no visual points are awarded.
critical_gate_reasoning.note: The guard does not clear any critical defect. It only prevents a previously positive result from surviving when the current still/temporal evidence chain can no longer be proven.

implementation_readiness.reason: Gate lifecycle coverage improved, but the reserved seven readiness points still require an actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime session and real render evidence.

expected_score_impact_not_awarded.all_categories: No direct pixel score increase. The change protects the validity of future category scores by preventing stale PASS persistence.
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: Evidence-integrity confidence improves because a current temporal candidate/coherence proof is re-required for any persisted PASS.
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Lighting/shadows/reflections: Evidence-integrity confidence improves because current render provenance/candidate freshness must remain valid; no lighting point is claimed.

preservation.scope: Only UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA additions in substantive commits.
